title: Module test B2.4 · Change and production

blocks.text: Module test B2.4 · Change and production
Instructions

Week 248 of the calendar, after verification of B2-17 → B2-23 and INT-06 (including INT-A and INT-B exercises) and, for varieties, of EGY-18 and MAG-01 MAG-03 (MAG-04 is in progress and does not enter the test). Duration: approx. 130 minutes for parts A/E, plus 20 minutes of interview with the tutor. Work without notes; the dictionary is only allowed in part D. Fix it with the solution. Part B scripts are at the beginning of solutions: read them to speakers of the varieties indicated or to the tutor, without you reading them. The text of Part A is without vowels.

rows: Reading: An article on a public discourse and its reactions
Listening: a talk show with switching, a Levant debate, a presentation in Egyptian read
Language: fuṣḥā spoken, variety, media, migration, oral speech, rhetoric, relationship, Moroccan
Translation from Arabic to English: a speech (heading)
Writing: neutral Arabic synthesis of a debate in Levant (heading)
Oral production: intervention with questions, Egyptian educated, Moroccan (heading)

blocks.text: Total 50

Overcoming. At least 38 points above 50 and at least 3 on 4 in each criterion of headings (parts D, E, F); for the Arabic corritezza of part E sufficient 2 on 4. If you do not pass the test, review the weaker unit during the first few weeks of B2-24 and repeat the tutor test within the week 250. Reading speed (does not enter the score). Before answering the questions in part A, read the text once silently with the stopwatch: the text has about 340 words. Objective: 90 words per minute.

1. What did the minister announce? Which part of the plan is a precise commitment and what remains to be defined (INT-06)?
2. In the minister's quote, he identifies two rhetorical figures (with the Arab name) and explains their function.

F · Oral production (8 points)
With the tutor, about 20 minutes.

1. Intervention (8 minutes). The tutor proposes three themes; Choose one and have five minutes of preparation (only Playlist). You speak three minutes in fuṣḥā When you speak, then answer two questions, one of which is an objection (B2-22).

2. Egyptian educated (6 minutes). The tutor interprets an Egyptian colleague in a meeting: present in two minutes a short project (theme chosen by the tutor), then answer a question and a reserve, with the formulas of EGY-18.
3. Moroccan (6 minutes). The tutor reads a short vocal message in darija twice: summarize it in English.

Then the tutor interprets Lalla Zhor at the table: answer with the formulas of hospitality (MAG-03). Evaluation: Accuracy 1–4 + Fluidity and interaction 1–4. Part F assesses the tutor; Without tutors, it remains unfinished.
